verdict.rationale: Yapily documents a ready-built, white-label hosted UI with pre-built institution selection and consent screens for AIS flows. It requires no frontend engineering for consent and authorisation, handles SCA and bank redirects automatically, and supports custom branding. Connected access is represented by a consent token used to fetch accounts. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of the server-side session-creation step, the widget/SDK launch mechanics, and how the consent token is handed back after the hosted flow, plus any independent or hands-on corroboration.
